name: Gran Meliá Fenix
insider_take: This legendary palace hotel has been Madrid's most prestigious address since 1956, hosting royalty, celebrities, and diplomats in the heart of the capital's Golden Triangle.
whats_special: The Gran Meliá Fenix occupies a prime corner of Plaza de Colón, steps from the Prado Museum and Retiro Park. Its rooftop terrace offers breathtaking 360-degree views of Madrid's skyline, while the hotel's classic façade conceals luxuriously renovated interiors that blend Spanish elegance with contemporary comfort.
pro_tip: Book a Red Level suite for exclusive access to the spectacular rooftop terrace and personalized concierge service that can secure impossible-to-get reservations at Madrid's top restaurants.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you within walking distance of the Golden Triangle of Art (Prado, Reina Sofía, and Thyssen museums), while the nearby Salamanca district offers world-class shopping. The rooftop bar is perfect for sunset cocktails overlooking the city's historic center.
pros: Prime location in Madrid's Golden Triangle shopping district
Elegant luxury accommodations with classic Spanish design
cons: Busy urban location with city noise
